item.title: Marjorie Taylor Greene says Trump 'does not have any faith'
item.description: Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene, R-Ga., recently suggested that her decision to resign from Congress came in part because Charlie Kirk's assassination convinced her that she was contributing to a toxic political culture. #MarjorieTaylorGreene #DonaldTrump #JeffreyEpstein #NewYorkTimes

item.title: Franklin Graham attributes rising church attendance to young people's rejection of 'anti-God socialism'
item.description: Evangelist Franklin Graham, CEO of Samaritan's Purse and the Billy Graham Evangelistic Association, has attributed reported increased church attendance among younger Americans to their rejection of "anti-God socialism." #FranklinGraham #CharlieKirk #GenerationZ #Millennials #Barna #Evangelicals #God

item.title: First lesbian archbishop laments people leaving church over her sexuality: 'Very hurtful'
item.description: The Most Rev. Cherry Vann, the first openly lesbian archbishop in the world, recently lamented that some people are leaving her church in protest of her gender and sexuality. #CherryVann #ChurchofWales #Anglicanism #AnglicanCommunion #UnitedKingdom

item.title: Reform UK MP says Britain must be 'confidently Christian' again
item.description: Reform MP Danny Kruger has spoken of the need for Britain to once more assert itself as a country with a long and rich Christian heritage. #ReformUK #DannyKruger #Christianheritage

item.title: Pastor’s wife details harrowing battle with Malaysian gov’t to free abducted husband Raymond Koh
item.description: Susanna Liew has spent nearly nine years fighting the Malaysian government over the abduction of her husband, Pastor Raymond Koh, who was taken in broad daylight on a street in a Kuala Lumpur suburb. #SusannaLiew #Malaysia #PastorRaymondKoh #Malaysia #abduction

item.title: Top New Year's resolutions: Americans want more family time, prayer in 2026
item.description: As Americans look ahead to 2026, “spending more time with family” and “praying more” are among the top 10 most common New Year’s resolutions. #YouGov #NewYearsresolutions #Prayer #2026

item.title: HHS freezes childcare funds to Minnesota after report on Somali daycare centers: 'Blatant fraud'
item.description: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services froze all federal child care payments to Minnesota on Tuesday, following a viral report exposing alleged rampant fraud among Somali day care centers in the state. #Minnesota #TimWalz #USDepartmentofHealthandHumanServices #politics

item.title: Congolese refugee influx tops 88,000 in Burundi, churches appeal for help
item.description: Tens of thousands of Congolese civilians have crossed into Burundi in recent weeks, fleeing a violent offensive by M23 rebels in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo that has overwhelmed border communities and prompted churches to appeal for urgent international support. #Burundi #Congoleserefugees #Congo #civilwar

item.title: Zohran Mamdani to become first NYC mayor sworn in on Quran: 'Highly symbolic'
item.description: New York City Mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani will take his oath of office on multiple versions of the Quran when he's sworn in as the city's first Muslim mayor on Thursday. #ZohranMamdani #NewYorkCity #Quran #Islam #politics

item.title: Rwanda’s president defends forced closure of Evangelical churches: ‘Den of bandits’
item.description: Rwandan President Paul Kagame defended the government's forced closure of Evangelical churches, accusing them of being a “den of bandits” led by deceptive relics of colonialism. #Rwanda #PresidentPaulKagame #EvangelicalChurches #Colonialism #ReligiousFreedom
